note: Reproduced adversarial payload: a second receipt with the same idempotency_key, state settled, readback_checksum matching attempted_checksum, and prior_receipt_ids pointing at the conflicted receipt, but with NO resolution_ref. violates: invariant: resolving a conflict or unknown attempt into settled or writing requires a recorded resolution_ref
